name: Paid Summer High School Botany Internship
what_you_do: Work in the garden's labs on real plant research with its plant collection. Five weeks in person, Monday to Friday, 9 am to 4 pm.
who_can_apply: You must be at least 16. You like botany, plant biology, ecology or gardening. It is run through the Miami-Dade County Public Schools Summer Youth Internship Program. Only Miami-Dade public school students get school credit.
pay_detail: Stipend at the end of the program (amount not stated)
deadline_text: The 2026 application closed March 6, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form. Add 1 letter of recommendation from a science teacher.
notes: Next year's dates are not posted. Look for a similar spring deadline. Recent undergraduate and graduate internships on the same page are not for high schoolers.
